privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_body: Comply does not collect personal data. When you submit a URL for scanning, we only process the URL and its publicly accessible HTTP response data (headers, SSL certificate info, cookies, and page content). We do not store or track IP addresses, browser fingerprints, or any personal identifiers.
privacy.s2_body: Scan results are stored temporarily to display the report to you and to maintain a public history of recent scans. No personally identifiable information is associated with scan results. We may use aggregated, anonymized scan data to improve our scanning engine.
privacy.s3_body: Scan results are stored in our database. You may request deletion of any scan result by contacting us. We retain scan data only as long as necessary to provide the service.
privacy.s4_body: Comply uses a minimal session cookie to maintain your scan history during your visit. We do not use tracking cookies, advertising cookies, or third-party analytics cookies.
privacy.s5_body: Comply does not share data with third parties. The scanning process fetches publicly available information from the URLs you submit — this is the only external network activity.
privacy.s6_body: For privacy-related inquiries, please contact us at

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1_body: By using Comply (comply.kaki.llc), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.s2_body: Comply provides automated compliance scanning of publicly accessible websites. The service analyzes SSL/TLS configuration, HTTP security headers, legal page availability, and cookie consent mechanisms.
terms.s3_body: You agree not to: scan URLs you do not own without permission; attempt to overload or abuse the scanning service; use Comply for any illegal purpose. We reserve the right to rate-limit or block excessive usage.
terms.s4_body: Comply provides an automated assessment for informational purposes only. It does not constitute legal advice. Scores and recommendations are generated by algorithms and may not reflect all compliance requirements in every jurisdiction. Always consult a qualified legal professional for compliance matters.
terms.s5_body: Comply is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any damages arising from your use of the service, including but not limited to reliance on scan results or inability to use the service.
terms.s6_body: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms. Last updated: July 1, 2026. Contact:
